text: 主策略
同一时间只由一个主策略组合记忆视图；切换后从下一轮对话生效。
默认三层
运行时常驻，档案与长期记忆按需读取
通用
全部来源可用，由模型决定如何使用
记忆增强
为当前主策略开启可选行为；切换后立即生效。
主动记录
在当前对话中识别并保存值得长期保留的事实
轻量上下文
减少常驻内容，同时保留按需读取能力
范围组合
按稳定顺序组合当前可用的记忆来源

Main strategy
One main strategy composes the memory view at a time; a switch applies from the next turn.
Default three-tier
Resident runtime memory, on-demand documents and durable memory
General
Every source available; the model decides how to use each
Memory enhancements
Enable optional behavior for the selected main strategy. Changes apply immediately.
Active capture
Identify and retain durable facts from the current conversation
Light context
Reduce resident content while keeping on-demand reads available
Scoped composition
Compose currently available memory sources in a stable order
